    def test_view_non_admin(sheet_name, test_name, prompt, section_name, entry_name, evaluation_metrice, evaluation_model, client, ragmetric, generate, view_helpers_factory):
        """
        Test that non-admin users can view configuration settings for 2 random entries per sheet, but only on the first prompt if prompt is a list/array. Evaluation matches test_view, including conversational follow-up logic.
        """
        import ast
        import uuid
        import io, sys, datetime
        allure.dynamic.parent_suite(sheet_name)
        allure.dynamic.suite("view_non_admin")
        allure.dynamic.sub_suite(test_name)
        exec_time = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        allure.attach(exec_time, name="Execution Time", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        stdout_capture = io.StringIO()
        old_stdout = sys.stdout
        sys.stdout = stdout_capture
        try:
            # Generate a single view prompt dynamically using section and item descriptions from Excel sheets
            try:
                sections_data = load_sections()
            except Exception:
                sections_data = []
            section_desc = None
            for s in sections_data:
                if s.get('SECTION_NAME') == section_name:
                    section_desc = s.get('SECTION_DESC')
                    break
    
            # Get item description from entries XLSX
            try:
                entries_data = load_entries()
            except Exception:
                entries_data = []
            item_desc = None
            for e in entries_data:
                if e.get('ENTRY_NAME') == entry_name:
                    item_desc = e.get('ITEM_DESC')
                    break
    
            prompt_to_use = generate.view_query(section_desc or "", item_desc or "", section_name, entry_name)
            chat_id = client.create_chat()
            allure.attach(chat_id, name="Chat ID", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            # Initialize helpers to reuse metadata validation logic
            helpers = view_helpers_factory(chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
            ask_result = client.ask(chat_id=chat_id, user_query=prompt_to_use, user_type="Non Admin")
            text_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            latency = ask_result.get("latency")
            expected_response = generate.expected_answer(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, query=prompt_to_use, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            allure.attach(str(latency), name="Latency", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            allure.attach(str(prompt_to_use), name="Prompt", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            allure.attach(str(expected_response), name="Expected Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            allure.attach(str(text_response), name="LLM Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            if metadata and metadata.get("type") in ["info"]:
                # Validate metadata when agent returns info
                helpers.validate_metadata_match(metadata)
                # Use helper for answer correctness to mirror admin view test behavior
                helpers.evaluate_answer_correctness(prompt_to_use, text_response, expected_response, 0)
            elif metadata and metadata.get("type") == "error":
                allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert False, f"Error response received: {text_response}\nMetadata: {metadata}"
            else:
                # Delegate 3-turn conversational handling to helper with Non Admin user_type

                    prompt_used=prompt_to_use,
                    expected_response=expected_response,

                    user_type="Non Admin"
                )
